notes.title: Minor Patch - Screen Resolution Sizes
notes.content: [p]Hey Everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Hope you're enjoying the Demo, and if you have an advanced copy of the full release, then I hope you're enjoying that too![/p][p][/p][p]Just a quick bug fix:[/p][list][*][p]fixed a bug with various screen sizes, particularly 16:10 aspect ratios. The game has been designed for 1920x1080p (16:9), but also works well for any other resolution. Please let me know if this is still an issue for your resolution/monitor![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update on Release Date
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504067/e61c95e69cd78221a25cbc57466ea994819c4c7a.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We have decided to delay the release of the game until September (instead of the planned date of 25th July) to ensure the game has been thoroughly tested.[/p][p]It's been a rough combo of sickness, testing taking longer than expected, and having other commitments take priority recently.[/p][p]But enough with the excuses... This Update's update on differences between the Demo and Full Release are: [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="135,151,"][tr][th colwidth="135"][p][/p][/th][th colwidth="151"][p]Demo[/p][/th][th][p]Full Release[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Crest resources[/p][/td][td colwidth="151"][p]Not available[/p][/td][td][p]Each King has a corresponding Crest resource, which when used quickens the pace of the game by increasing favour gain and immediately ending Grace Period.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Ascension Powder resource[/p][/td][td colwidth="151"][p]Adds one of two unique effects to a random card in hand when used.[/p][/td][td][p]Passively gives +1 upgrade whenever a Card is upgraded (e.g. accelerating a card in the Vault, or using the Temper Hand unique effect). This keeps upgrading Cards in this way relevant into the late game. Ascension powder can be used if a particular Perk is unlocked and active, where it greatly buffs a number of Cards equal to the amount of Ascension powder used.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing :)[/p]
